summary: Eliminated all 2 remaining sorries in DiscreteGameTransfer.lean. Added discrete_point_challenge_with_sel_ordering helper lemma (~170 lines) that uses inductive cell-finding with sub-interval decompositions to find b with ordering preservation for all sorted selections. Phase 3 (Proposition 7) is now fully complete with 0 sorries.

continuation_context.fix_summary: The old approach obtained b from the base decomposition independently of selections, making ordering transfer impossible. The fix: discrete_point_challenge_with_sel_ordering finds the sub-interval of the sorted partition containing b' by case-splitting on the last sorted selection (induction on n), then gets b from that sub-interval's NM decomposition. For the boundary selection, ordering comes directly from the sub-interval WC. For non-boundary selections, ordering follows trivially (b is above or below the entire sorted sequence). For x/y boundaries, pivot_chain_order chains through the sub-interval boundary.
